name: BBTool
description: Bollinger Bands - volatility indicator with upper/lower bands based on standard deviations. Price touching bands may indicate overbought/oversold conditions or breakouts.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT). Use the same symbol that was passed to the market data tool.

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d). Must match the timeframe used when fetching the market data.

fields.label: Period (SMA)
fields.description: Period for middle band SMA. CHOOSE based on timeframe: 10-15 for short-term trading, 20 for standard, 30-50 for longer-term trend channels.

fields.label: Standard Deviation Multiplier
fields.description: Standard deviations for bands. CHOOSE based on volatility: 1.5 for low volatility stocks, 2.0 for standard, 2.5-3.0 for highly volatile stocks to avoid false breakout signals.
